title: Water temperature
plainLanguage: How warm or cold the water is.
ecologicalEffect: Temperature shapes which plants and animals can live in the water. Warmer water holds less dissolved oxygen.

title: Turbidity
plainLanguage: How cloudy the water is due to suspended material.
ecologicalEffect: Cloudy water blocks sunlight that underwater plants need, and the suspended material can settle onto habitat where fish and other animals live.

title: Dissolved oxygen
plainLanguage: The amount of oxygen available in the water for fish and other aquatic organisms.
ecologicalEffect: Fish and other aquatic life breathe oxygen dissolved in the water, and low levels can stress or suffocate them. Algae blooms can use up oxygen this way.

title: pH
plainLanguage: How acidic or basic the water is.
ecologicalEffect: Most aquatic plants and animals depend on pH staying within a fairly narrow range, and extremes can stress them.
